Bengal Teachers Recruitment Scam: Supreme Court Upholds Cancellation Of 25,753 Teacher Appointments
India Today
11300000 subscribers

The Supreme Court has upheld the Calcutta High Court's order cancelling 25,753 teaching and non-teaching staff appointments in Bengal's 2016 job-for-cash scam. The top court stated the entire selection process was tainted by manipulation and fraud. While the BJP demands Mamata Banerjee's resignation, the Chief Minister accuses the BJP government of targeting Bengal and stands with the affected teachers.
